contentText: The Venezuelan government of interim president Delcy Rodriguez announced that it started releasing a 'large' number of political prisoners, describing it as a gesture of goodwill. US President Donald Trump claimed credit for the move, saying it had come at Washington's request. According to rights groups, only a handful of detainees have been released since the announcement, families have been waiting outside prisons across the country for updates on their loved ones.
